task_text: What is the average GDP per capita in 2020 for countries that experienced earthquakes in the last 30 days?

arguments.geodataset: Earthquakes occurences and magnitude March 15- February 14 2025

arguments.filters: {"NAME_EN": ["Indonesia", "Chile", "Bolivia", "Peru", "Argentina", "India", "China", "Ethiopia", "Tanzania", "Morocco", "Nicaragua", "Kazakhstan", "Tajikistan", "Russian Federation", "Kyrgyz Republic", "Tunisia", "Romania", "Poland", "Greece", "Iraq", "Italy", "Iran, Islamic Rep.", "Croatia", "Dominican Republic", "El Salvador", "Guatemala", "Myanmar", "Afghanistan", "Bosnia and Herzegovina", "Uganda", "Ecuador", "Colombia", "Portugal", "United States", "Canada", "Mexico", "Papua New Guinea", "Australia", "Fiji", "Philippines", "Japan", "Puerto Rico", "Solomon Islands", "Vanuatu", "New Zealand"]}

final_response:
## Result

The average GDP per capita (2020) for the **45 countries** that experienced earthquakes is **≈ US$ 12,516**.

### Methodology
1. **Earthquakes** (9,176 events) were spatially joined to **country boundaries**, selecting countries whose polygons contain earthquake epicenters → **45 countries** (e.g., Indonesia, Chile, Peru, Japan, United States, Turkey-region… actually confirmed list includes Indonesia, Chile, China, Iran, Italy, Japan, Mexico, New Zealand, Philippines, etc.).
2. These countries were merged with the **World Bank GDP per capita (current US$)** series and filtered to the **2020** column.
3. Summary statistics computed on the 2020 values (46 polygon features; one name duplicated in the boundary layer, negligible effect).

### Statistics (GDP per capita, 2020, current US$)
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Count | 46 (0 missing) |
| **Mean** | **12,515.94** |
| Std. dev. | 15,656.25 |
| Min | 512.06 (Afghanistan) |
| 25th pct | 2,789.25 |
| Median | 5,379.30 |
| 75th pct | 14,078.55 |
| Max | 64,317.40 (United States) |

**Answer: ≈ US$ 12,516 per capita** (2020), with a wide spread — from ~$512 to ~$64,317 — reflecting the mix of low-, middle- and high-income countries along active tectonic zones.
